minimalSourceCorrectionRequirements.requirement: Preserve original outer audit/native artifact validation and full-byte hashing. Add a separate context integrity phase that can throw WORKER_REQUEST_DENIED; keep support selection as a separate false/unknown predicate. Do not use one catch-all false result for both.

For the known context schema, map original validateExecutionContext(scope) failures and exact closed known-schema failures to denied. Check original numeric/reference/provenance/count bounds and unambiguous compact JSON serialization. Do not enforce queued/empty-memory/no-supplements as integrity requirements.

Separate goal/source digest and membership joins from one-source support cardinality. A malformed observable goal/provenance ref/digest association denies. A structurally valid original context with additional source provenance, healthy supplement/observation fields, retained/dropped backgrounds or valid nonempty memory stays unknown. Do not change the source base-only exact check to a throwing check that rejects healthy original optional source fields.

Separate recognizable protected task/work JSON integrity from support values. Exact known fields, scalar/array/policy types, canonical bounds, scope/version/auth and actual goal-content joins deny when inconsistent. Healthy other task status/generation, active alternatives, nonempty valid vectors and additional healthy sections remain unsupported/unknown. Missing/reordered sections with otherwise healthy metadata are unsupported; corruption of a recognized joined JSON section is malformed. No guessed live task record or generation proof is introduced.

Distinguish healthy unknown contract/materialKind/verification discriminators explicitly from malformed known schema. Original validator uses CONTEXT_INVALID for both, so error-code-only mapping or a blanket catch-to-denied replacement cannot classify them. A future schema is never passed or treated as examined; validate applicable known shared associations before unknown and do not invent validation rules for unknown fields or rewrite input tags to simulate a supported record.

Run applicable known context integrity and observable joins before all unsupported returns at lines90–92, including extra-material/policy/goal cases. Unsupported flags can be collected while strict checks continue. No positive coverage follows from integrity alone; only unchanged supported-domain payload equality can produce passed.

Keep original source bytes, unknown/repair recipes, native carriers/guards, full context digest/payload formula, model selection, grant/currentness and budgets unchanged. Only the new pure recipe needs source correction. Resubmit literal candidate/hash/effects for independent review before authoring or executing malformed-domain cases.
